metadata.name: Private application notes remain isolated between student accounts
metadata.description: Verify through visible application screens that one student's private application note is unavailable to another student and remains unchanged after the second student's visit. This browser case complements the existing required backend 403/404 enforcement test.

planSteps.description: Sign in using VAR_{other_email} and VAR_{password}. Open /scholarships/twente-uts-2027. Wait until its Save or Unsave control appears. Save the opportunity if necessary.

Expand My application plan. Set Private notes to:[TEST ONLY] Portal privacy verification note
Click Save my plan, verify Your plan is saved, reload, and confirm the note persists.

Sign out. Sign in using VAR_{username} and VAR_{password}. Open the same scholarship. Assert the owner’s note is absent. If this account has its own application plan, expand it and assert its Private notes field does not contain the owner’s note. Assert no Operator navigation item appears.
Sign out and return to the original account. Reload the scholarship and expand its application plan. Assert the original private note is unchanged.

metadata.name: Requirement changes update eligibility and create one preference-aware notification
metadata.description: Using only the labelled controlled scholarship, verify reliable operator scenario switching, eligible-to-ineligible recalculation, one notification per accepted version, replay deduplication, and suppression when Changes notifications are disabled.

planSteps.description: Sign in using configured VAR_{operator_email} and VAR_{password}. Open /operator → Isolated source verification. Switch between Publication and replay and Eligibility and notifications, ending on the latter. Assert the selected button is pressed and its controls appear. Click Publish valid snapshot to establish the master-level baseline.

Sign out and sign in using VAR_{other_email} and VAR_{password}. Dismiss the study-profile prompt if necessary. In /settings/profile, save Nigeria citizenship, Ghana residence, completed bachelor qualification, intended future qualification master, and Computer Science. Finish saving, reload, and verify the intended qualification remains master.

Save [TEST ONLY] Controlled change scholarship. Enable in-app Changes notifications and disable email notifications. Recalculate matches if needed. Assert the baseline assessment is eligible before publishing the changed requirement.

Click Process queued jobs. Wait for Pending events = 0, Pending deliveries = 0, and Queue drained. If the bounded batch limit leaves runnable jobs, repeat processing. Then sign out and sign in as the student. Assert version C evaluates as not_eligible with reason VALUE_NOT_ACCEPTED, and exactly one change notification belongs to version C.

Sign out and sign in as the operator. Replay Publish changed requirement. Assert the accepted version remains C. Drain queued jobs, return to the student account, and assert there is still exactly one notification for C. Historical notifications for other versions are not duplicates.

As the operator, publish a valid reverse change and record version R, but do not process jobs. Switch to the student, disable the Changes topic, and save preferences. Switch back to the operator and drain queued jobs. Return to the student and assert no notification exists for reverse version R. Restore the Changes preference.

metadata.name: GLOCAL uses one canonical scholarship URL across all seven destinations
metadata.description: Verify that GLOCAL appears once under each participating destination and that every catalogue and study-location scholarship link uses the exact same canonical official URL.

planSteps.description: Open /scholarships. Search for GLOCAL, select Germany, choose All application windows, and apply filters. Assert exactly one GLOCAL result.
Reload. Assert the search and Germany selection persist. Record the result’s internal scholarship href.
Repeat for United Kingdom, Spain, Sweden, Colombia, Japan, and Netherlands. For every country, assert exactly one GLOCAL result and the same internal scholarship href.

For every country’s result, inspect the Official scholarship link’s actual href. Assert literal equality with:https://globallocal-erasmusmundus.eu/about-glocal/programme-overview/
Compare the href itself, before following redirects. Query parameters, fragments, encoded variants, or missing comparisons must fail.

1. Open the GLOCAL detail page. Assert participating institutions include University of Glasgow, Kyoto University, and Universidad de Los Andes. Assert all seven study-location scholarship-information links use that exact canonical href. Separate evidence citations and application guidance may use other official pages.
